name: user_rating_count
description: Number of ratings the user has given

name: user_rating_std
logic: std(rating) by user_id, 0 if single rating

name: user_ratings_last_30d
description: Ratings in the 30 days before as_of

name: user_active_span_days
description: Days between first and last interaction

name: user_preferred_genre
description: Genre the user rates most often

name: user_genre_diversity
description: Distinct genres rated / total genres (breadth of taste)

name: user_mainstreamness
description: Mean popularity percentile of items the user rated

name: item_unique_users
description: Distinct users who rated the item

name: item_bayesian_avg_rating
description: Mean rating shrunk to global mean (robust for few ratings)
logic: (C*m + sum(r)) / (C + n), C = median item count, m = global mean

name: item_ratings_last_30d
description: Ratings in the 30 days before as_of (trending)

name: ug_share
description: Share of the user's ratings that fall in the genre

name: ug_avg_rating
description: User's mean rating within the genre

name: ug_affinity
description: Combined preference score used by the hybrid model
